routing_contract.fourth_down: excluded because fourth-down decision owns that snap
routing_contract.pass: play_type=pass or qb_scramble, excluding spikes and tries
routing_contract.rush: play_type=run, excluding qb_scramble, qb_kneel, spikes, and tries
routing_contract.selection: one pass-or-rush family before any pass, designed-rush, or red-zone-rush outcome is resolved
